dataSource.provider: UBS Global Wealth Report 2026 (56-market sample, not global)
dataSource.notes: Household wealth at end-2025, summed from the UBS Global Wealth Report 2026 wealth bands.
dataSource.method: UBS GWR 2026 (published 2026-06-30), end-2025: wealth-pyramid band totals 250.59+200.72+63.16+3.22 tn = 517.69tn for UBS's 56-market sample (>92% of global wealth). Its p.37 regional table sums to 492.4tn, but its printed shares (EMEA 26.6%, APAC 32.8%) imply ~517.7tn, so the Americas row (185,040 = '40.6%') is the inconsistent cell (checked on rendered PDF pages 23 and 37). Stored 550,000 'for 2024' exceeds UBS's own end-2025 total, so it was not a UBS figure.

dataSource.notes: R$40.6 billion the FGC had to guarantee after Brazil's Central Bank liquidated Banco Master on 18 Nov 2025, at R$5.38 per dollar; R$40.2 billion paid by Sep 2026.
dataSource.method: OFFICIAL (FGC): BCB liquidated Banco Master, Master de Investimento, Letsbank and Master Corretora by Atos do Presidente 1.369/1.371/1.372/1.373 of 2025-11-18. FGC total to pay R$40.6bn (17 Jan 2026 statement, revised from R$41.3bn; ~800k creditors); paid R$40.2bn (98.82%) to 722k creditors by 2026-09-10. Related separate liquidations: Will Bank R$5.9bn + R$0.14bn paid, Banco Pleno R$4.6bn; FGC estimate for all three R$51.7bn (2026-04-28). No official total-liabilities figure found (BCB open-data dataset ir-33923798000100 holds only Pillar 3 links; BCB note cited 0.57% of SFN assets, via press). Banco Master Multiplo (liquidated 2026-03-17 after RAET since 2025-11-18, per press) is outside the FGC table's stated scope. Convert with PTAX yourself.

totalCalculation.reason: A liability covered by a guarantee fund, not wealth

dataSource.notes: Estimated loss to the US Deposit Insurance Fund from the 10 Mar 2023 failure, after the FDIC covered every deposit, insured or not.

NET LOSS after asset recoveries, not gross payout, so not like-for-like with the Banco Master figure (gross amount guaranteed). FDIC special-assessment page later cites ~$16.7bn to recover as of 2025-09-30 for the two banks combined; per-bank split not found there.
